cat >> journal.md <<'EOF'

## [2026-06-11 11:55] — DSA-style sparse attention, 1M context, FP4 training, cache worker recycling

**TL;DR:** Three features built sandbox-first: (1) DeepSeek-V3.2-style sparse attention (lightning indexer + top-k key selection + always-kept local window) with a query-chunked long path enabling a 1M-token max context; (2) NVFP4-style FP4 quantization-aware training (E2M1 grid, block-16 scales, straight-through estimator) on all linear layers, default-on; (3) token-cache build workers now recycle per 8M-token generation, fixing a memory leak that held ~28 GB RSS. 182+ tests pass, lint/pyaot clean. The 2B verification matrix is pending.

**Long description:** User task: 1M-token context window, DeepSeek sparse attention ("deepseek V4 thing"), any further small-model attention techniques, and FP4 training from now on, with tests and a pros/cons report vs the latest scores.md champion (60.41 overall, accd37b). Implementation, model side (src/mythosmini/model/transformer.py): Attention gained index_q/index_k (dim→index_dim=16) and a learnable index_gate scalar; index_scores = ReLU(q_idx·k_idx)/sqrt(index_dim) (DSA lightning indexer, single head); select_sparse_indices masks non-causal keys, force-includes the most recent local_window=64 keys via a large additive bonus, then top-k (index_top_k=128) per query; the short path (seq <= sparse_chunk_threshold=4096) injects gate*score as an SDPA attn_mask bias on selected positions (-inf elsewhere) so the indexer trains end-to-end through attention gradients — a deliberate single-phase simplification of the paper's two-stage KL-distilled indexer training, which needs a dense teacher phase we cannot afford at 1M params; the long path (forward_long) chunks queries (sparse_chunk_queries=1024), gathers only top-k K/V per query (attend_selected), true O(n*k) memory. RoPE: rope_base raised 10000→10,000,000 (long-context standard practice) and ensure_rope_length grows the cos/sin cache on demand up to max_context_len=1,048,576; forward raises ValueError beyond it. Params 1,047,168→1,074,825 (+27,657, +2.6%). FP4 (src/mythosmini/training/fp4.py): quantize_fp4 snaps block-16 groups to the signed E2M1 grid {0,±0.5,±1,±1.5,±2,±3,±4,±6} scaled by per-block amax/6 (NVFP4 scheme minus the FP8-scale quantization, since this is QAT simulation on bf16 tensor cores — RTX 5090 has no FP4 matmul exposed in torch 2.10); _Fp4SteFunction passes gradients straight through; Fp4Linear subclasses nn.Linear keeping the plain weight key so checkpoints/SLERP/benchmarks are untouched; linear_type(config) selects it for all attention/FFN/LoRA linears when ModelConfig.fp4_weights (default True per user instruction); embeddings and norms stay full precision. Memory leak (src/mythosmini/data/cache.py): the live 2B run's 8 cache workers each grew to ~3.5 GB RSS (28 GB total) because HF datasets streaming accumulates state over a worker's life — generation_plan/generation_limits split the build into per-8M-token generations of fresh spawn workers (shards capped at 96), _build_recycled/_run_generation/_write_stream restructure the writer so the bar and handle persist across generations. Also killed 7 orphaned 10 GB cache workers from a dead 2026-06-10 20:04 run (~70 GB reclaimed) plus the in-flight run A and its workers at user request during the leak hunt.

**What worked:** Sandbox-first throughout: tests/test_sparse_attention.py (12 tests: causality, local-window forcing, top-scoring selection, short==long path equivalence at full top_k, indexer gradient flow, RoPE extension, max-context rejection, 16k chunked forward, 1M/rope-base config contract, param budget) written and seen failing before any source change, then passing; tests/test_fp4.py (11 tests: grid membership, grid exactness, zero blocks, non-multiple shapes, bounded error, STE gradient identity, Fp4Linear==manual quantized matmul, state-dict key, fp4 model loss decreases over 30 steps, default-on, opt-out) same; cache recycling proven by 3 new tests in tests/test_token_cache.py (generation_plan quotas/caps/validation, generation_limits exact cover). Suite minus the heavy pipeline e2e: 182 passed. make lint, make pyaot (72 files) clean. Speed probe at micro 32, seq 512: sparse 25.3 ms/step, sparse+FP4 36.8 ms/step.

**What failed:** (1) First transformer rewrite left a placeholder forward_long — caught immediately and rewritten in full before any test ran (no placeholder ever committed). (2) tests/e2e/test_train_entry.py::test_full_pipeline_end_to_end now exceeds its old runtime (timed out at 900 s; faulthandler stack showed it inside stm_epoch backward) — sparse attention's bias-mask SDPA path is slower than the old is_causal flash path, multiplying the tiny-budget pipeline test's cost; investigation of the exact phase cost was still running at entry time. (3) My first edit of tests/test_fp4.py misplaced two lines across test boundaries; fixed before running.

**What was kept / discarded:** Kept all three features, all tests, docs entries for every touched function. Killed run A (runs/2026-06-11 morning, warmup-pipeline verification) before completion at user request — the warmup pipeline change (93c84b9) therefore still lacks its scores.md row.

**Open questions / next steps:** (1) Speed: the short-path sparse attention builds an O(n²) bias mask, losing flash-attention; at seq 512 it is ~2x slower than dense was — acceptable for the experiment but a fused kernel or FlexAttention port is the obvious follow-up. (2) The 2B verification runs (one per feature per the training-change rule) are pending; the queue is sparse-attention run then FP4 run. (3) test_full_pipeline_end_to_end needs either a smaller STM config knob for tests or patience — resolve before declaring the contract green.
